builds.name: Void Spike: AP self-heal experiment
builds.summary: Investigate high one Void Spike self-heal output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Void Spike self-heal output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The extracted heal helper is 55/75/95/115/135 + 0.5 AP. AP and eligible heal modifiers can improve this self-heal even though spike damage uses bonus AD. Dawncore converts purchased mana regeneration into further AP and heal-and-shield power; Visage is an owner-only received-heal modifier.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 30%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected; no free permanent stacks. Stop observed damage scoring on death, cap observed healing at missing HP, and report raw output separately. Owner starts at 30% health with enough missing HP to observe the heal. Use ordinary W, no evolution assumed, and stand within its actual explosion heal radius. Record own maximum HP, AP and eligible heal modifiers; one spike detonation, no lifesteal or item-active healing.
